cbsros.label: CBS rest of season
cbsros.message: CBS rest of season disagrees with the other projections on 42% of players this week. Reviewed.
reasons: standard: QB far out of line (bias +5.6, outliers 82%, n=22)

resolution.note: Warn in half/standard (46-47%, QB bias +5.3/+5.5, RB -6.4/-6.8). Native per-game projections compared source against source (median of each player's native over the mean of the other two, shared players, weeks 5-7 from data/history and the current fixture): CBS ROS QB +17 to +19%, RB -12 to -20%; Razzball QB -19 to -23%; ESPN RB +7 to +9%, TE -7 to -8%. The pattern is stable week to week and identical in full, half and standard, and reception scoring matches across the three (half-PPR share 0.50, same full-minus-standard gap by position), so no scoring path is broken. Razzball's live QB page (updated 2026-10-23) shows Josh Allen at 20.3 STD PPG, the fixture value; his stat line rescores to 223.1 vs 223.2 published. With three sources the leave-one-out consensus is the mean of two, so one low Razzball QB line or one low CBS ROS RB line moves the other sources' outlier rates. Rates sit 1-3 points over the fixed 45% ceiling; projection sources have no trailing baseline (JEG-952 tunes these thresholds).
